title: Owner agrees with role-separation direction; operational recommendations added before redesign
summary: The owner agrees with the proposed supplier/admin versus account-manager breakdown and asks for further recommendations. The role blueprint now treats that direction and manager-submitted numbers with admin assignment/transfer control as the working onboarding default, without treating all detailed operational policies as finalized. New recommendations cover one shared SIM detail record, supplier-enabled versus recipient-eligible catalogs, a boundary for edits after submission starts, actionable forecast deadlines and missing coverage, spend limits, role-specific attention messages, exception recovery and proving a small complete fulfillment loop. Budget amounts, exact renewal lead time, pause/resume details and billing remain undecided. No preview redesign, live API call, login, OTP, payment, notification or deployment occurred.

evidence.location: Owner agreement and request for further recommendations
evidence.description: Owner confirms the prior role-planning response and asks what else is recommended.
Agreement status and additional operating-policy recommendations are recorded separately from settled requirements.

nextSteps: Define the SIM-detail information and the exact renewal policy before another full dashboard visual pass.
Keep new policy recommendations distinct from agreed roles and existing authorization.
